title: HoloUI Container Preview Document
description: Defines the holographic card HoloUI draws when a player looks at a container. Documents live in plugins/holoui/previews/ and are hot reloaded. Documentation grade only: the Java parser (PreviewDocumentParser) is the format's source of truth, and it enforces rules this schema cannot express.

match.description: What this document draws, how strongly it claims it, and the variables it draws with.

variants.description: Alternate variable sets for the same elements. A variant both restyles AND extends matching: the registry grades a target against the base match and every variant, so a material or entity named only in a variant makes the whole document resolvable for it. Variants are tried in declaration order; the first whose blocks/entities match wins, and its vars are merged over the document's own.

card.description: The chrome drawn around the elements: frame, panel, tray, title bar and title. Omit the whole object for bare content with no chrome.

elements.description: The content drawn inside the card, in paint order. A document that emits nothing draws no preview at all.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: A string in the preview expression DSL, evaluated against the previewed container's live state. Only cell.color and label.text are re-evaluated while the preview is on screen (every four ticks); every other expression field is evaluated once when the preview is built. Grammar: number, string (single- or double-quoted, escapes \\ \' \" \n), colour (#RGB, #RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB), true/false, variable (dotted, e.g. surge.active or vars.accent), array literal ([a, b, c], used by palette), call, unary ! and -, * / %, + -, < <= > >=, == !=, &&, ||, and a ? b : c. Strings concatenate with +. % is Java's truncating remainder (-1 % 3 is -1) while mod() floors (mod(-1, 3) is 2); both throw on a zero divisor. Functions: clamp, lerp, min, max, floor, ceil, round, abs, mod, sin, cos, rgb, argb, alpha, mix, palette, str, fixed, plain, readable, lang, count, occupied, item. See the HoloUI docs pages /holoui/07-expressions-placeholders and /holoui/09-container-previews in the central VolmitSoftware/docs repo.

number.title: Number or expression
number.description: A JSON number constant, or an expression string evaluating to a number.

color.title: Colour or expression
color.description: An ARGB colour. As a JSON number it is the unsigned 32-bit value, so a value with no high byte set is fully transparent. As a string it is either a colour literal or any expression producing one: #RGB and #RRGGBB are opaque because the parser prefixes FF, only #AARRGGBB carries its own alpha, and rgb() likewise packs an opaque alpha while argb() and alpha() set it explicitly.

boolean.title: Boolean or expression
boolean.description: A JSON boolean constant, or an expression string evaluating to a boolean.

names.title: Match Names
names.description: Material or entity type names, uppercased before matching. '*' is the only wildcard, e.g. '*_SHULKER_BOX'. Names listed here and in any variant both count toward resolving the document. An exact name beats a glob at the same priority. An unknown name warns and still compiles, so a document survives a version that dropped the type.

vars.title: Variables
vars.description: Document-authored constants, read in expressions as vars.<name>. Values are JSON primitives only and are NEVER parsed as expressions, with one exception: a string leading with '#' is read as a colour literal so a variant can carry an accent as "#FFB02E26" without losing the alpha byte to a signed int. A leading '#' that is not a valid colour literal fails to compile.

match.title: Match Object
match.description: Match criteria. A document with neither blocks nor entities nor special claims nothing and is never resolved.

blocks.description: Block materials this document draws. A variant's own blocks extend this set rather than narrowing it.

special.description: Marks this document as the one the plugin looks up by role rather than by target. 'enderChest' draws the viewer's own ender chest instead of a tile entity, 'locked' is the target-less card shown when a viewer may not open the container, and 'anyInventoryHolder' is the fallback for an inventory-holding entity no document names. Read from the top-level match only.

priority.description: Highest priority wins. Within one priority an exact name beats a glob, which beats the anyInventoryHolder fallback; a genuine tie is broken by document name and warned about. Shipped documents use 10, so a user document at 20 overrides one. Read from the top-level match only. Default 0.

variant.title: Variant Object
variant.description: The match shape again, but only blocks/entities and vars are read: special and priority belong to the document. A variant's blocks/entities add to what the document matches, they do not restrict it.

card.title: Card Object
card.description: Declaring a card at all asks for the chrome, so framed defaults to true here.

framed.description: Whether to draw the chrome. Evaluated once when the preview is built. Default true.

title.description: Expression producing the title text, evaluated once when the preview is built. The result is parsed for legacy '&' codes and MiniMessage tags, so a title styles itself inline. The shipped idiom is "'&f&l' + (customName != '' ? customName : plain(lang(vars.titleKey)))".

accent.description: Expression producing the chrome accent colour, evaluated once when the preview is built. Only the low 24 bits are used. Defaults to a neutral grey.

minHalfWidth.description: Minimum half-width of the panel in pixels, so a narrow card does not collapse around a short title. Default 82.

element.title: Element Object
element.description: One drawn element. Required fields depend on type: panel needs width, height and color; cell needs size and color; slot needs size and index; label needs text.

type.description: panel: a flat rectangle. cell: a square swatch, the unit every gauge and flame is built from. slot: an inventory well that renders the item in it. label: parsed text.

x.description: Horizontal offset in pixels from the card centre, positive right. Default 0.

y.description: Vertical offset in pixels from the card centre, positive up. Default 0.

z.description: Depth order, higher draws in front. Defaults to 1 for panel, 4 for cell and slot, 6 for label.

width.description: Panel width in pixels. Required for type panel.

height.description: Panel height in pixels. Required for type panel.

size.description: Square edge length in pixels. Required for types cell and slot.

color.description: Fill colour. Required for types panel and cell. On a cell this is one of the only two live fields: it is re-evaluated every four ticks while the preview is on screen. On a panel it is evaluated once when the preview is built.

wellColor.description: Colour of the well behind a slot's item. Type slot only. Default #FF15151B.

index.description: Inventory slot index this well renders. Required for type slot. Guard it against inventory.size; nothing clamps it for you.

text.description: Expression producing the label text. Required for type label. One of the only two live fields: re-evaluated every four ticks while the preview is on screen, unless it folds to a constant, in which case it is parsed once and reused. The result is parsed for legacy '&' codes and MiniMessage tags, so concatenating differently prefixed fragments in one expression yields one multi-run label.

background.description: Text background colour. Type label only. Default fully transparent.

visible.description: Skip this element when false. Evaluated once when the preview is built (per iteration inside a repeat), not per frame: an element hidden at build time stays hidden for the life of that preview. Default true.

repeat.description: Emits this element once per index, with the index bound to a loop variable every field of the element can read.

count.description: How many copies to emit. Evaluated once when the preview is built, not per frame, so a grid sizes itself from inventory.size at open time. A constant count above 1024 is a compile error and rejects the document; a dynamic count is truncated to 1024 at build with a reported error.

var.description: Name the 0-based index is bound to inside this element. Default 'i'. Must be a valid identifier and must not collide with 'vars' or a state variable name, which would make it unreachable.
